questions.answerHtml:
Words 701 to 800 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

---

701. deliver

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈlɪvər/
  • English Meaning: To take something to a person or place.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Giao hàng; giao.
  • Example: The company will deliver the package tomorrow.
  • Example Translation: Công ty sẽ giao gói hàng vào ngày mai.

702. delivery

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈlɪvəri/
  • English Meaning: The act of taking something to someone.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự giao hàng.
  • Example: Delivery is free for orders over $50.
  • Example Translation: Giao hàng miễn phí cho đơn trên 50 đô la.

703. demand

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈmænd/
  • English Meaning: A strong request or need for something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhu cầu; yêu cầu.
  • Example: There is high demand for skilled workers.
  • Example Translation: Có nhu cầu cao đối với lao động có tay nghề.

704. demonstrate

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdemənstreɪt/
  • English Meaning: To show clearly how something works or that something is true.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chứng minh; trình bày.
  • Example: The teacher demonstrated the experiment.
  • Example Translation: Giáo viên đã trình bày thí nghiệm.

705. dentist

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdentɪst/
  • English Meaning: A doctor who treats teeth.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nha sĩ.
  • Example: I have an appointment with the dentist.
  • Example Translation: Tôi có cuộc hẹn với nha sĩ.

706. deny

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈnaɪ/
  • English Meaning: To say that something is not true.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phủ nhận.
  • Example: He denied the accusation.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy phủ nhận lời buộc tội.

707. department

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈpɑːrtmənt/
  • English Meaning: A division of an organization.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phòng ban; khoa.
  • Example: She works in the marketing department.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy làm việc ở phòng marketing.

708. departure

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈpɑːrtʃər/
  • English Meaning: The act of leaving a place.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự khởi hành.
  • Example: The departure time is 7 a.m.
  • Example Translation: Thời gian khởi hành là 7 giờ sáng.

709. depend

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈpend/
  • English Meaning: To be affected by or rely on something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phụ thuộc.
  • Example: Success depends on hard work.
  • Example Translation: Thành công phụ thuộc vào sự chăm chỉ.

710. depressed

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈprest/
  • English Meaning: Feeling very unhappy for a long period.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chán nản; trầm cảm.
  • Example: He felt depressed after the loss.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy cảm thấy chán nản sau mất mát.

711. depressing

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈpresɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: Making people feel sad or hopeless.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Gây buồn chán.
  • Example: The news was depressing.
  • Example Translation: Tin tức đó thật buồn.

712. depth

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /depθ/
  • English Meaning: The distance from top to bottom.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Độ sâu.
  • Example: The depth of the river is unknown.
  • Example Translation: Độ sâu của con sông chưa được biết.

713. describe

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈskraɪb/
  • English Meaning: To give details about someone or something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mô tả.
  • Example: Can you describe the situation?
  • Example Translation: Bạn có thể mô tả tình hình không?

714. description

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈskrɪpʃən/
  • English Meaning: A statement that gives details.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự mô tả.
  • Example: The product description was accurate.
  • Example Translation: Mô tả sản phẩm rất chính xác.

715. desert

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdezərt/ (noun)
  • English Meaning: A dry area with little rain.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sa mạc.
  • Example: Few plants survive in the desert.
  • Example Translation: Rất ít cây cối sống được ở sa mạc.

716. deserve

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈzɜːrv/
  • English Meaning: To be worthy of something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Xứng đáng.
  • Example: She deserves a reward.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy xứng đáng nhận phần thưởng.

717. design

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈzaɪn/
  • English Meaning: A plan or drawing; to create such a plan.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thiết kế.
  • Example: The building has a modern design.
  • Example Translation: Tòa nhà có thiết kế hiện đại.

718. designer

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈzaɪnər/
  • English Meaning: A person who designs things.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà thiết kế.
  • Example: She is a fashion designer.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy là nhà thiết kế thời trang.

719. desire

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈzaɪər/
  • English Meaning: A strong wish for something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mong muốn; khao khát.
  • Example: He has a strong desire to succeed.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy có khát vọng thành công mạnh mẽ.

720. desk

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /desk/
  • English Meaning: A table used for writing or working.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bàn làm việc.
  • Example: My books are on the desk.
  • Example Translation: Sách của tôi ở trên bàn.

721. desperate

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdespərət/
  • English Meaning: Having little hope and willing to do anything.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tuyệt vọng.
  • Example: They were desperate for help.
  • Example Translation: Họ tuyệt vọng cần sự giúp đỡ.

722. despite

  • Type: Preposition
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈspaɪt/
  • English Meaning: Without being affected by something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mặc dù.
  • Example: We went outside despite the rain.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi ra ngoài mặc dù trời mưa.

723. dessert

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈzɜːrt/
  • English Meaning: Sweet food eaten after a meal.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Món tráng miệng.
  • Example: Ice cream is my favorite dessert.
  • Example Translation: Kem là món tráng miệng yêu thích của tôi.

724. destination

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˌdestɪˈneɪʃən/
  • English Meaning: The place someone is traveling to.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Điểm đến.
  • Example: Paris is a popular tourist destination.
  • Example Translation: Paris là một điểm đến du lịch nổi tiếng.

725. destroy

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈstrɔɪ/
  • English Meaning: To damage something completely.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phá hủy.
  • Example: The fire destroyed the building.
  • Example Translation: Đám cháy đã phá hủy tòa nhà.

726. detail

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdiːteɪl/
  • English Meaning: A small piece of information.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chi tiết.
  • Example: Tell me the details of the plan.
  • Example Translation: Hãy cho tôi biết các chi tiết của kế hoạch.

727. detailed

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdiːteɪld/
  • English Meaning: Containing many details.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chi tiết.
  • Example: The report is very detailed.
  • Example Translation: Báo cáo rất chi tiết.

728. detect

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈtekt/
  • English Meaning: To discover or notice something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phát hiện.
  • Example: The device can detect smoke.
  • Example Translation: Thiết bị có thể phát hiện khói.

729. detective

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈtektɪv/
  • English Meaning: A police officer who investigates crimes.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thám tử.
  • Example: The detective solved the case.
  • Example Translation: Thám tử đã phá được vụ án.

730. determine

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈtɜːrmɪn/
  • English Meaning: To decide or discover exactly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Xác định; quyết định.
  • Example: The test will determine the result.
  • Example Translation: Bài kiểm tra sẽ xác định kết quả.

731. determined

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈtɜːrmɪnd/
  • English Meaning: Having a strong desire to do something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Quyết tâm.
  • Example: She is determined to succeed.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy quyết tâm thành công.

732. develop

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈveləp/
  • English Meaning: To grow or improve over time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phát triển.
  • Example: Children develop quickly.
  • Example Translation: Trẻ em phát triển nhanh chóng.

733. development

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈveləpmənt/
  • English Meaning: Growth, progress, or improvement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự phát triển.
  • Example: Technology development is rapid.
  • Example Translation: Sự phát triển công nghệ rất nhanh.

734. device

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /dɪˈvaɪs/
  • English Meaning: A piece of equipment made for a purpose.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thiết bị.
  • Example: This device measures temperature.
  • Example Translation: Thiết bị này đo nhiệt độ.

735. diagram

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdaɪəɡræm/
  • English Meaning: A simple drawing that explains something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sơ đồ.
  • Example: The diagram shows the process.
  • Example Translation: Sơ đồ cho thấy quy trình.

736. dialogue

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdaɪəlɔːɡ/
  • English Meaning: A conversation between people.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đối thoại.
  • Example: The dialogue was interesting.
  • Example Translation: Cuộc đối thoại rất thú vị.

737. diamond

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdaɪəmənd/
  • English Meaning: A valuable transparent gemstone.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kim cương.
  • Example: She wears a diamond ring.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đeo một chiếc nhẫn kim cương.

738. diary

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdaɪəri/
  • English Meaning: A book for recording personal experiences.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhật ký.
  • Example: She writes in her diary every day.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy viết nhật ký mỗi ngày.

739. dictionary

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdɪkʃəneri/
  • English Meaning: A book that explains word meanings.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Từ điển.
  • Example: I checked the dictionary for the meaning.
  • Example Translation: Tôi tra từ điển để tìm nghĩa.

Vietnamese Meaning: Ví dụ. - Example: This sentence is an example of good writing. - Example Translation: Câu này là một ví dụ về cách viết tốt. 940. excellent - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈeksələnt/ - English Meaning: Extremely good. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xuất sắc. - Example: She did an excellent job. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đã làm rất xuất sắc. 941. except - Type: Preposition, Conjunction - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsept/ - English Meaning: Not including someone or something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngoại trừ. - Example: Everyone came except Tom. - Example Translation: Mọi người đều đến ngoại trừ Tom. 942. exchange - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ - English Meaning: The act of giving one thing and receiving another. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trao đổi. - Example: We exchanged ideas during the meeting. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi đã trao đổi ý tưởng trong cuộc họp. 943. excited - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsaɪtɪd/ - English Meaning: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hào hứng. - Example: The children were excited about the trip. - Example Translation: Những đứa trẻ rất hào hứng với chuyến đi. 944. excitement - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/ - English Meaning: A feeling of great enthusiasm. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự hào hứng. - Example: There was great excitement before the match. - Example Translation: Có sự hào hứng lớn trước trận đấu. 945. exciting - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ/ - English Meaning: Making people feel excited. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thú vị; hào hứng. - Example: It was an exciting game. - Example Translation: Đó là một trận đấu rất thú vị. 946. excuse - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈskjuːs/ - English Meaning: A reason given to explain or avoid something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lý do; xin lỗi. - Example: He made an excuse for being late. - Example Translation: Anh ấy đưa ra lý do cho việc đến muộn. 947. executive - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪɡˈzekjətɪv/ - English Meaning: A person with management authority. - Vietnamese Meaning: Giám đốc điều hành. - Example: She is a senior executive. - Example Translation: Cô ấy là một giám đốc cấp cao. 948. exercise - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈeksərsaɪz/ - English Meaning: Physical activity to improve health. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bài tập; tập thể dục. - Example: Regular exercise is good for health. - Example Translation: Tập thể dục thường xuyên tốt cho sức khỏe. 949. exhibit - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪɡˈzɪbɪt/ - English Meaning: To display something publicly. - IPA (US): /ˌeksɪˈbɪʃən/ - English Meaning: A public display of art or other items. - Vietnamese Meaning: Triển lãm. - Example: We visited an art exhibition. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi đã tham quan một triển lãm nghệ thuật. 951. exist - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ɪɡˈzɪst/ - English Meaning: To be real or present. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tồn tại. - Example: Dinosaurs no longer exist. - Example Translation: Khủng long không còn tồn tại nữa. 952. existence - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪɡˈzɪstəns/ - English Meaning: The state of being alive or real. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự tồn tại. - Example: Scientists debate the existence of life on other planets. - Example Translation: Các nhà khoa học tranh luận về sự tồn tại của sự sống trên các hành tinh khác. 953. exit - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1, B2 - IPA (US): /ˈeksɪt/ - English Meaning: A way out of a place. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lối ra; thoát ra. - Example: Please use the nearest exit. - Example Translation: Vui lòng sử dụng lối ra gần nhất. 954. expand - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspænd/ - English Meaning: To become larger or increase. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mở rộng. - Example: The company plans to expand overseas. - Example Translation: Công ty dự định mở rộng ra nước ngoài. 955. expect - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspekt/ - English Meaning: To think that something will happen. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mong đợi. - Example: We expect good results. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi mong đợi kết quả tốt. 956. expectation - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˌekspekˈteɪʃən/ - English Meaning: A belief about what will happen. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự kỳ vọng. - Example: The results exceeded expectations. - Example Translation: Kết quả vượt quá kỳ vọng. 957. expected - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspektɪd/ - English Meaning: Anticipated or predicted. - Vietnamese Meaning: Được mong đợi. - Example: The expected delivery date is Monday. - Example Translation: Ngày giao hàng dự kiến là thứ Hai. 958. expense - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspens/ - English Meaning: The cost of something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chi phí. - Example: Travel expenses were high. - Example Translation: Chi phí đi lại rất cao. 959. expensive - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspensɪv/ - English Meaning: Costing a lot of money. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đắt tiền. - Example: This watch is expensive. - Example Translation: Chiếc đồng hồ này rất đắt tiền. 960. experience - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspɪriəns/ - English Meaning: Knowledge gained through doing something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Kinh nghiệm; trải nghiệm. - Example: She has years of teaching experience. - Example Translation: Cô ấy có nhiều năm kinh nghiệm giảng dạy. 961. experienced - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspɪriənst/ - English Meaning: Having knowledge or skill gained through experience. - Vietnamese Meaning: Có kinh nghiệm. - Example: She is an experienced teacher. - Example Translation: Cô ấy là một giáo viên có kinh nghiệm. 962. experiment - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsperɪmənt/ - English Meaning: A scientific test to discover or prove something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thí nghiệm. - Example: The students conducted an experiment. - Example Translation: Các học sinh đã tiến hành một thí nghiệm. 963. expert - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈekspɜːrt/ - English Meaning: A person with a high level of knowledge or skill. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chuyên gia. - Example: She is an expert in marketing. - Example Translation: Cô ấy là chuyên gia về tiếp thị. 964. explain - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspleɪn/ - English Meaning: To make something clear by giving details. - Vietnamese Meaning: Giải thích. - Example: Can you explain this rule? - Example Translation: Bạn có thể giải thích quy tắc này không? 965. explanation - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˌekspləˈneɪʃən/ - English Meaning: A statement that makes something clear. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lời giải thích. - Example: His explanation was easy to understand. - Example Translation: Lời giải thích của anh ấy rất dễ hiểu. 966. explode - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsploʊd/ - English Meaning: To burst violently with a loud noise. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nổ. - Example: The balloon exploded suddenly. - Example Translation: Quả bóng bay bất ngờ phát nổ. 967. exploration - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˌekspləˈreɪʃən/ - English Meaning: The activity of traveling or investigating to learn more. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự khám phá. - Example: Space exploration continues to advance. - Example Translation: Việc khám phá không gian tiếp tục phát triển. 968. explore - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsplɔːr/ - English Meaning: To travel through or study something to learn about it. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khám phá. - Example: Tourists came to explore the island. - Example Translation: Du khách đến để khám phá hòn đảo. 969. explosion - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈsploʊʒən/ - English Meaning: A violent burst with noise and energy. - Vietnamese Meaning: Vụ nổ. - Example: The explosion damaged nearby buildings. - Example Translation: Vụ nổ làm hư hại các tòa nhà gần đó. 970. export - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈekspɔːrt/ (n.), /ɪkˈspɔːrt/ (v.) - English Meaning: To send goods to another country for sale. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xuất khẩu. - Example: Vietnam exports coffee worldwide. - Example Translation: Việt Nam xuất khẩu cà phê trên toàn thế giới. 971. expose - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspoʊz/ - English Meaning: To make something visible or known. - Vietnamese Meaning: Phơi bày; làm lộ ra. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bày tỏ. - Example: She expressed her opinion clearly. - Example Translation: Cô ấy bày tỏ ý kiến của mình một cách rõ ràng. 973. expression - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈspreʃən/ - English Meaning: A way of showing feelings or ideas. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự biểu lộ; biểu cảm. - Example: His facial expression changed suddenly. - Example Translation: Biểu cảm khuôn mặt của anh ấy thay đổi đột ngột. 974. extend - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstend/ - English Meaning: To make something longer or larger. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mở rộng; kéo dài. - Example: They decided to extend the deadline. - Example Translation: Họ quyết định gia hạn thời hạn. 975. extent - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstent/ - English Meaning: The size or degree of something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mức độ; phạm vi. - Example: We don't know the full extent of the damage. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi chưa biết toàn bộ mức độ thiệt hại. 976. external - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstɜːrnəl/ - English Meaning: Coming from outside. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bên ngoài; ngoại vi. - Example: External factors affected the project. - Example Translation: Các yếu tố bên ngoài đã ảnh hưởng đến dự án. 977. extra - Type: Adjective, Noun, Adverb - CEFR Level: A1, B1 - IPA (US): /ˈekstrə/ - English Meaning: More than what is usual or needed. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thêm; bổ sung. - Example: We need extra chairs. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi cần thêm ghế. 978. extraordinary - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstrɔːrdəneri/ - English Meaning: Very unusual or impressive. - Vietnamese Meaning: Phi thường. - Example: She showed extraordinary talent. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đã thể hiện tài năng phi thường. 979. extreme - Type: Adjective, Noun - CEFR Level: A2, B2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstriːm/ - English Meaning: Very great in degree or intensity. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cực độ; cực đoan. - Example: The region experiences extreme weather. - Example Translation: Khu vực này trải qua thời tiết khắc nghiệt. 980. extremely - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ɪkˈstriːmli/ - English Meaning: Very; to a great degree. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cực kỳ. - Example: The task was extremely difficult. - Example Translation: Nhiệm vụ đó cực kỳ khó khăn. 981. eye - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /aɪ/ - English Meaning: The organ used for seeing. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mắt. - Example: She has blue eyes. - Example Translation: Cô ấy có đôi mắt xanh. 982. face - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B1 - IPA (US): /feɪs/ - English Meaning: The front part of the head; to deal with something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khuôn mặt; đối mặt. - Example: We must face the problem. - Example Translation: Chúng ta phải đối mặt với vấn đề. 983. facility - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /fəˈsɪləti/ - English Meaning: A place or equipment provided for a purpose. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cơ sở vật chất. - Example: The sports facility is modern. - Example Translation: Cơ sở thể thao rất hiện đại. 984. fact - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fækt/ - English Meaning: Something known to be true. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự thật. - Example: It's a fact that water boils at 100°C. - Example Translation: Nước sôi ở 100°C là một sự thật. 985. factor - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈfæktər/ - English Meaning: One of the things that influences a result. - Vietnamese Meaning: Yếu tố. - Example: Cost is an important factor. - Example Translation: Chi phí là một yếu tố quan trọng. 986. factory - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈfæktəri/ - English Meaning: A building where goods are manufactured. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà máy. - Example: The factory employs hundreds of workers. - Example Translation: Nhà máy tuyển dụng hàng trăm công nhân. 987. fail - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /feɪl/ - English Meaning: To be unsuccessful. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thất bại. - Example: Don't be afraid to fail. - Example Translation: Đừng sợ thất bại. 988. failure - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈfeɪljər/ - English Meaning: Lack of success. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự thất bại. - Example: Failure can teach valuable lessons. - Example Translation: Thất bại có thể dạy những bài học quý giá. 989. fair - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /fer/ - English Meaning: Treating everyone equally and reasonably. - Vietnamese Meaning: Công bằng. - Example: The teacher was fair to all students. - Example Translation: Giáo viên đối xử công bằng với tất cả học sinh. 990. fairly - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈferli/ - English Meaning: Quite or reasonably. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khá; tương đối. - Example: The exam was fairly easy. - Example Translation: Bài thi khá dễ. 991. faith - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /feɪθ/ - English Meaning: Strong belief or trust in someone or something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Niềm tin; đức tin. - Example: She has faith in her team. - Example Translation: Cô ấy có niềm tin vào đội của mình. 992. fall - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɔːl/ - English Meaning: To move downward; the season after summer. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngã; mùa thu. - Example: Be careful not to fall. - Example Translation: Hãy cẩn thận đừng ngã. 993. FALSE - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɔːls/ - English Meaning: Not true or correct. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sai; không đúng. - Example: The statement is false. - Example Translation: Tuyên bố đó là sai. 994. familiar - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /fəˈmɪliər/ - English Meaning: Well known or easily recognized. - Vietnamese Meaning: Quen thuộc. - Example: The song sounds familiar. - Example Translation: Bài hát nghe rất quen thuộc. 995. family - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈfæməli/ - English Meaning: A group of people related to each other. - Vietnamese Meaning: Gia đình. - Example: My family lives in Ho Chi Minh City. - Example Translation: Gia đình tôi sống ở Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. 996. famous - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈfeɪməs/ - English Meaning: Known by many people. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nổi tiếng. - Example: She is a famous singer. - Example Translation: Cô ấy là một ca sĩ nổi tiếng. 997. fan - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /fæn/ - English Meaning: A person who greatly likes someone or something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Người hâm mộ. - Example: He is a fan of football. - Example Translation: Anh ấy là người hâm mộ bóng đá. 998. fancy - Type: Adjective, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈfænsi/ - English Meaning: Attractive, expensive, or to like something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sang trọng; thích. - Example: They stayed in a fancy hotel. - Example Translation: Họ ở trong một khách sạn sang trọng. 999. fantastic - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /fænˈtæstɪk/ - English Meaning: Extremely good or impressive. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tuyệt vời. - Example: We had a fantastic time. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi đã có khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời. 1000. far - Type: Adverb, Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɑːr/ - English Meaning: At a great distance. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xa. - Example: The school is not far from here. - Example Translation: Trường học không xa đây.
questions.answerHtml:
Words 901 to 1000 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

---

901. entirely

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ɪnˈtaɪərli/
  • English Meaning: Completely; fully.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hoàn toàn.
  • Example: I entirely agree with your opinion.
  • Example Translation: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với ý kiến của bạn.

902. entrance

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈentrəns/
  • English Meaning: A door, gate, or way into a place.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lối vào.
  • Example: Wait for me at the main entrance.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đợi tôi ở lối vào chính.

903. entry

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈentri/
  • English Meaning: The act of entering or a record in a list.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự vào; mục ghi.
  • Example: Entry to the museum is free.
  • Example Translation: Việc vào bảo tàng là miễn phí.

904. environment

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
  • English Meaning: The natural world or surrounding conditions.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Môi trường.
  • Example: We should protect the environment.
  • Example Translation: Chúng ta nên bảo vệ môi trường.

905. environmental

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmentl/
  • English Meaning: Related to the environment.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thuộc môi trường.
  • Example: Environmental issues affect everyone.
  • Example Translation: Các vấn đề môi trường ảnh hưởng đến mọi người.

906. episode

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈepɪsoʊd/
  • English Meaning: One part of a television or radio series.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tập phim.
  • Example: I watched the latest episode last night.
  • Example Translation: Tôi đã xem tập mới nhất tối qua.

907. equal

  • Type: Adjective, Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1, B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈiːkwəl/
  • English Meaning: Being the same in value, amount, or status.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bằng nhau; bình đẳng.
  • Example: All students should have equal opportunities.
  • Example Translation: Tất cả học sinh nên có cơ hội bình đẳng.

908. equally

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈiːkwəli/
  • English Meaning: In the same way or to the same degree.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Một cách ngang nhau.
  • Example: The prize was divided equally.
  • Example Translation: Giải thưởng được chia đều.

909. equipment

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈkwɪpmənt/
  • English Meaning: Tools or machines needed for a task.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thiết bị.
  • Example: The laboratory has modern equipment.
  • Example Translation: Phòng thí nghiệm có thiết bị hiện đại.

910. error

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈerər/
  • English Meaning: A mistake.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lỗi; sai sót.
  • Example: There is an error in the report.
  • Example Translation: Có một lỗi trong báo cáo.

911. escape

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈskeɪp/
  • English Meaning: To get away from danger or confinement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Trốn thoát.
  • Example: The prisoner escaped from jail.
  • Example Translation: Tù nhân đã trốn khỏi nhà tù.

912. especially

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈspeʃəli/
  • English Meaning: More than usual or more than others.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đặc biệt là.
  • Example: I like fruit, especially oranges.
  • Example Translation: Tôi thích trái cây, đặc biệt là cam.

913. essay

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈeseɪ/
  • English Meaning: A short piece of writing on a topic.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bài luận.
  • Example: She wrote an essay about climate change.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy viết một bài luận về biến đổi khí hậu.

914. essential

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈsenʃəl/
  • English Meaning: Extremely important or necessary.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thiết yếu.
  • Example: Water is essential for life.
  • Example Translation: Nước là thiết yếu cho sự sống.

915. establish

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/
  • English Meaning: To start or create something that will last.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thành lập; thiết lập.
  • Example: They established a new company.
  • Example Translation: Họ thành lập một công ty mới.

916. estate

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ɪˈsteɪt/
  • English Meaning: A large area of land or property.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bất động sản; tài sản.
  • Example: The estate covers hundreds of acres.
  • Example Translation: Khu đất đó rộng hàng trăm mẫu Anh.

917. estimate

  • Type: Noun, Verb

tầng. - Example: The book fell on the floor. - Example Translation: Cuốn sách rơi xuống sàn nhà. 1063. flour - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /flaʊər/ - English Meaning: Powder made from grains used in baking. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bột mì. - Example: We need flour to make bread. - Example Translation: Chúng ta cần bột mì để làm bánh mì. 1064. flow - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /floʊ/ - English Meaning: To move steadily and continuously. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chảy; con ruồi. - Example: Birds can fly long distances. - Example Translation: Chim có thể bay những quãng đường dài. 1068. flying - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈflaɪɪŋ/ - English Meaning: The activity of traveling through the air. - Vietnamese Meaning: Việc bay. - Example: Flying is faster than driving. - Example Translation: Đi máy bay nhanh hơn lái xe. 1069. focus - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈfoʊkəs/ - English Meaning: Special attention given to something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự tập trung; tập trung. - Example: Please focus on your work. - Example Translation: Hãy tập trung vào công việc của bạn. 1070. fold - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /foʊld/ - English Meaning: To bend something so that one part covers another. - Vietnamese Meaning: Gấp lại. - Example: Fold the paper in half. - Example Translation: Hãy gấp đôi tờ giấy. 1071. folk - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /foʊk/ - English Meaning: Traditional and related to ordinary people. - Vietnamese Meaning: Dân gian. - Example: We listened to folk music. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi nghe nhạc dân gian. 1072. follow - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈfɑːloʊ/ - English Meaning: To go after someone or obey instructions. - Vietnamese Meaning: Theo sau; làm theo. - Example: Please follow the instructions. - Example Translation: Hãy làm theo hướng dẫn. 1073. following - Type: Adjective, Preposition, Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ/ - English Meaning: Coming next or after. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tiếp theo. - Example: Answer the following questions. - Example Translation: Hãy trả lời các câu hỏi sau. 1074. food - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fuːd/ - English Meaning: Things that people and animals eat. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thức ăn. - Example: Healthy food is important. - Example Translation: Thức ăn lành mạnh rất quan trọng. 1075. foot - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fʊt/ - English Meaning: The lower part of the leg used for standing and walking. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bàn chân. - Example: My foot hurts after the walk. - Example Translation: Bàn chân tôi đau sau khi đi bộ. 1076. football - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈfʊtbɔːl/ - English Meaning: A popular team sport played with a ball. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bóng đá. - Example: Football is the most popular sport in the world. - Example Translation: Bóng đá là môn thể thao phổ biến nhất thế giới. 1077. for - Type: Preposition - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɔːr/ - English Meaning: Used to show purpose, benefit, or duration. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cho; vì. - Example: This gift is for you. - Example Translation: Món quà này dành cho bạn. 1078. force - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /fɔːrs/ - English Meaning: Strength or power used to make something happen. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lực; ép buộc. - Example: The force of the wind was strong. - Example Translation: Sức gió rất mạnh. 1079. foreign - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrən/ - English Meaning: Connected with another country. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nước ngoài. - Example: She speaks several foreign languages. - Example Translation: Cô ấy nói được nhiều ngoại ngữ. 1080. forest - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrɪst/ - English Meaning: A large area covered with trees. - Vietnamese Meaning: Rừng. - Example: The forest is home to many animals. - Example Translation: Khu rừng là nơi sinh sống của nhiều loài động vật. 1081. forever - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /fərˈevər/ - English Meaning: For all time; endlessly. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mãi mãi. - Example: I will remember this forever. - Example Translation: Tôi sẽ nhớ điều này mãi mãi. 1082. forget - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fərˈɡet/ - English Meaning: To fail to remember something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Quên. - Example: Don't forget your keys. - Example Translation: Đừng quên chìa khóa của bạn. 1083. forgive - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /fərˈɡɪv/ - English Meaning: To stop being angry with someone for a mistake. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tha thứ. - Example: She forgave him for the error. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đã tha thứ cho anh ấy vì lỗi đó. 1084. fork - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /fɔːrk/ - English Meaning: A tool used for eating with prongs. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cái nĩa. - Example: Use a fork to eat the salad. - Example Translation: Hãy dùng nĩa để ăn salad. 1085. form - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B1 - IPA (US): /fɔːrm/ - English Meaning: A type, shape, or document; to create. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hình thức; biểu mẫu; hình thành. - Example: Please fill out this form. - Example Translation: Vui lòng điền vào biểu mẫu này. 1086. formal - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrməl/ - English Meaning: Following official or traditional rules. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trang trọng; chính thức. - Example: Wear formal clothes to the event. - Example Translation: Hãy mặc trang phục trang trọng đến sự kiện. 1087. former - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrmər/ - English Meaning: Previous or earlier. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trước đây. - Example: He is a former teacher. - Example Translation: Ông ấy là một giáo viên trước đây. 1088. fortunately - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrtʃənətli/ - English Meaning: Happily; by good luck. - Vietnamese Meaning: May mắn thay. - Example: Fortunately, nobody was hurt. - Example Translation: May mắn thay, không ai bị thương. 1089. fortune - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrtʃən/ - English Meaning: Great wealth or luck. - Vietnamese Meaning: Vận may; tài sản lớn. - Example: He made a fortune in business. - Example Translation: Anh ấy đã kiếm được một gia tài từ kinh doanh. 1090. forty - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrti/ - English Meaning: The number 40. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bốn mươi. - Example: Forty students attended the class. - Example Translation: Có bốn mươi học sinh tham dự lớp học. 1091. forward - Type: Adverb, Adjective, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /ˈfɔːrwərd/ - English Meaning: Toward the front or ahead. - Vietnamese Meaning: Về phía trước; chuyển tiếp. - Example: She stepped forward to speak. - Example Translation: Cô ấy bước lên phía trước để phát biểu. 1092. found - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /faʊnd/ - English Meaning: To establish or start an organization, company, or institution. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thành lập. - Example: They founded the company in 2010. - Example Translation: Họ thành lập công ty vào năm 2010. 1093. four - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɔːr/ - English Meaning: The number 4. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bốn. - Example: There are four chairs in the room. - Example Translation: Có bốn chiếc ghế trong phòng. 1094. fourteen - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˌfɔːrˈtiːn/ - English Meaning: The number 14. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mười bốn. - Example: She is fourteen years old. - Example Translation: Cô ấy mười bốn tuổi. 1095. fourth - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /fɔːrθ/ - English Meaning: Coming after the third and before the fifth. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thứ tư. - Example: He finished fourth in the race. - Example Translation: Anh ấy về đích thứ tư. 1096. frame - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /freɪm/ - English Meaning: A structure that surrounds or supports something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khung; đóng khung. - Example: The picture is in a wooden frame. - Example Translation: Bức tranh được đặt trong một khung gỗ. 1097. free - Type: Adjective, Adverb, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B2 - IPA (US): /friː/ - English Meaning: Not costing money or not controlled by others. - Vietnamese Meaning: Miễn phí; tự do. - Example: Admission is free today. - Example Translation: Vé vào cửa hôm nay được miễn phí. 1098. freedom - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈfriːdəm/ - English Meaning: The right to act, speak, or think as you want. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tự do. - Example: Freedom of speech is important. - Example Translation: Tự do ngôn luận rất quan trọng. 1099. freeze - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /friːz/ - English Meaning: To become or make something very cold and solid. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đóng băng. - Example: Water freezes at 0°C. - Example Translation: Nước đóng băng ở 0°C. 1100. frequency - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈfriːkwənsi/ - English Meaning: The rate at which something happens or is repeated. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tần suất. - Example: The frequency of earthquakes has increased. - Example Translation: Tần suất động đất đã tăng lên.
questions.answerHtml:
Words 1001 to 1100 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

---

1001. farm

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /fɑːrm/
  • English Meaning: Land used for growing crops or raising animals.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nông trại; canh tác.
  • Example: My uncle owns a farm.
  • Example Translation: Chú tôi sở hữu một nông trại.

1002. farmer

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɑːrmər/
  • English Meaning: A person who works on a farm.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nông dân.
  • Example: The farmer grows vegetables.
  • Example Translation: Người nông dân trồng rau.

1003. farming

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɑːrmɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The activity of growing crops and raising animals.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nghề nông.
  • Example: Farming is important to the local economy.
  • Example Translation: Nông nghiệp rất quan trọng đối với nền kinh tế địa phương.

1004. fast

  • Type: Adjective, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fæst/
  • English Meaning: Moving or happening quickly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhanh.
  • Example: He is a fast runner.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy là một vận động viên chạy nhanh.

1005. fat

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /fæt/
  • English Meaning: A natural substance in food; overweight.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chất béo; béo.
  • Example: This food contains too much fat.
  • Example Translation: Thức ăn này chứa quá nhiều chất béo.

1006. father

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɑːðər/
  • English Meaning: A male parent.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cha; bố.
  • Example: My father works in a bank.
  • Example Translation: Bố tôi làm việc ở ngân hàng.

1007. fault

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /fɔːlt/
  • English Meaning: Responsibility for a mistake or problem.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lỗi; khuyết điểm.
  • Example: It was my fault.
  • Example Translation: Đó là lỗi của tôi.

1008. favor

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfeɪvər/
  • English Meaning: Kind help given to someone.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự giúp đỡ; ưu ái.
  • Example: Could you do me a favor?
  • Example Translation: Bạn có thể giúp tôi một việc được không?

1009. favorite

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfeɪvərɪt/
  • English Meaning: Liked more than others.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Yêu thích nhất.
  • Example: Blue is my favorite color.
  • Example Translation: Màu xanh là màu tôi thích nhất.

1010. fear

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /fɪr/
  • English Meaning: An unpleasant feeling caused by danger.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nỗi sợ hãi.
  • Example: She has a fear of heights.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy sợ độ cao.

1011. feather

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfeðər/
  • English Meaning: One of the soft parts covering a bird.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lông vũ.
  • Example: The bird lost a feather.
  • Example Translation: Con chim rụng một chiếc lông.

1012. feature

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfiːtʃər/
  • English Meaning: An important part or characteristic.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đặc điểm; tính năng.
  • Example: This phone has many useful features.
  • Example Translation: Chiếc điện thoại này có nhiều tính năng hữu ích.

1013. February

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfebrueri/
  • English Meaning: The second month of the year.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tháng Hai.
  • Example: My birthday is in February.
  • Example Translation: Sinh nhật tôi vào tháng Hai.

1014. federal

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfedərəl/
  • English Meaning: Relating to the central government.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Liên bang.
  • Example: The federal government announced new policies.
  • Example Translation: Chính phủ liên bang công bố các chính sách mới.

1015. fee

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /fiː/
  • English Meaning: An amount of money paid for a service.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phí.
  • Example: There is an entrance fee.
  • Example Translation: Có một khoản phí vào cửa.

1016. feed

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /fiːd/
  • English Meaning: To give food to a person or animal.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cho ăn.
  • Example: She feeds the cat every morning.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy cho mèo ăn mỗi sáng.

1017. feedback

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfiːdbæk/
  • English Meaning: Opinions about how well something is done.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phản hồi.
  • Example: The teacher gave useful feedback.
  • Example Translation: Giáo viên đưa ra những phản hồi hữu ích.

1018. feel

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fiːl/
  • English Meaning: To experience an emotion or sensation.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cảm thấy.
  • Example: I feel happy today.
  • Example Translation: Hôm nay tôi cảm thấy vui.

1019. feeling

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfiːlɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: An emotion or sense.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cảm giác; cảm xúc.
  • Example: I have a good feeling about this.
  • Example Translation: Tôi có cảm giác tốt về việc này.

1020. fellow

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfeloʊ/
  • English Meaning: Sharing the same activity or position.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đồng nghiệp; cùng hội.
  • Example: She helped her fellow students.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy giúp đỡ các bạn học cùng lớp.

1021. female

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfiːmeɪl/
  • English Meaning: Belonging to the sex that can have babies.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nữ; phụ nữ.
  • Example: The award went to a female athlete.
  • Example Translation: Giải thưởng thuộc về một nữ vận động viên.

1022. fence

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /fens/
  • English Meaning: A structure that surrounds an area.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hàng rào.
  • Example: They built a fence around the house.
  • Example Translation: Họ xây một hàng rào quanh ngôi nhà.

1023. festival

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfestɪvəl/
  • English Meaning: A special event with celebrations.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lễ hội.
  • Example: The city hosts a music festival every year.
  • Example Translation: Thành phố tổ chức lễ hội âm nhạc hằng năm.

1024. few

  • Type: Determiner, Pronoun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fjuː/
  • English Meaning: A small number of.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Một vài.
  • Example: Only a few people know the answer.
  • Example Translation: Chỉ có một vài người biết câu trả lời.

1025. fiction

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɪkʃən/
  • English Meaning: Literature about imaginary events.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tiểu thuyết; truyện hư cấu.
  • Example: She enjoys reading fiction.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy thích đọc tiểu thuyết.

1026. field

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /fiːld/
  • English Meaning: An area of land or a subject of study.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cánh đồng; lĩnh vực.
  • Example: He works in the medical field.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy làm việc trong lĩnh vực y tế.

1027. fifteen

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˌfɪfˈtiːn/
  • English Meaning: The number 15.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mười lăm.
  • Example: There are fifteen students present.
  • Example Translation: Có mười lăm học sinh có mặt.

1028. fifth

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fɪfθ/
  • English Meaning: Coming after the fourth and before the sixth.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thứ năm.
  • Example: She finished fifth in the race.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy về đích thứ năm.

1029. fifty

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɪfti/
  • English Meaning: The number 50.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Năm mươi.
  • Example: Fifty people attended the event.
  • Example Translation: Năm mươi người tham dự sự kiện.

1030. fight

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /faɪt/
  • English Meaning: To use force against someone or struggle against something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chiến đấu; cuộc chiến.
  • Example: They fought for their rights.
  • Example Translation: Họ đã đấu tranh cho quyền lợi của mình.

1031. figure

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɪɡjər/
  • English Meaning: A number, amount, or shape; to understand.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Con số; hình dáng; tính toán.
  • Example: The sales figures increased this year.
  • Example Translation: Các con số doanh số đã tăng trong năm nay.

1032. file

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /faɪl/
  • English Meaning: A collection of information or a document stored electronically.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tệp; hồ sơ.
  • Example: Save the file before closing the program.
  • Example Translation: Hãy lưu tệp trước khi đóng chương trình.

1033. fill

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fɪl/
  • English Meaning: To make something full.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Làm đầy.
  • Example: Please fill the bottle with water.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đổ đầy nước vào chai.

1034. film

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, B1
  • IPA (US): /fɪlm/
  • English Meaning: A movie or the act of recording moving images.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bộ phim; quay phim.
  • Example: We watched a film last night.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi xem một bộ phim tối qua.

1035. final

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfaɪnl/
  • English Meaning: Last in a series or process.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cuối cùng; trận chung kết.
  • Example: This is the final chapter.
  • Example Translation: Đây là chương cuối cùng.

1036. finally

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfaɪnəli/
  • English Meaning: At the end of a process or period.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cuối cùng.
  • Example: We finally reached our destination.
  • Example Translation: Cuối cùng chúng tôi đã đến đích.

1037. finance

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfaɪnæns/
  • English Meaning: The management of money.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tài chính.
  • Example: She works in finance.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy làm việc trong lĩnh vực tài chính.

1038. financial

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /faɪˈnænʃəl/
  • English Meaning: Related to money or finance.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thuộc tài chính.
  • Example: The company faces financial difficulties.
  • Example Translation: Công ty đang gặp khó khăn tài chính.

1039. find

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /faɪnd/
  • English Meaning: To discover or locate something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tìm thấy.
  • Example: I can't find my keys.
  • Example Translation: Tôi không thể tìm thấy chìa khóa của mình.

1040. finding

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: Information discovered as a result of research.

questions.answerHtml:
Words 1101 to 1200 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

---

1101. frequent

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfriːkwənt/
  • English Meaning: Happening often.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thường xuyên.
  • Example: He makes frequent trips abroad.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy thường xuyên đi công tác nước ngoài.

1102. frequently

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfriːkwəntli/
  • English Meaning: Often.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thường xuyên.
  • Example: She frequently visits her grandparents.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy thường xuyên thăm ông bà.

1103. fresh

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /freʃ/
  • English Meaning: New, clean, or recently produced.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tươi; mới.
  • Example: We bought fresh vegetables.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi mua rau tươi.

1104. Friday

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfraɪdeɪ/
  • English Meaning: The sixth day of the week.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thứ Sáu.
  • Example: The meeting is on Friday.
  • Example Translation: Cuộc họp diễn ra vào thứ Sáu.

1105. friend

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /frend/
  • English Meaning: A person you know and like.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bạn bè.
  • Example: My friend lives nearby.
  • Example Translation: Bạn tôi sống gần đây.

1106. friendly

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfrendli/
  • English Meaning: Kind and pleasant.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thân thiện.
  • Example: The staff are very friendly.
  • Example Translation: Nhân viên rất thân thiện.

1107. friendship

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfrendʃɪp/
  • English Meaning: The relationship between friends.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tình bạn.
  • Example: Their friendship lasted many years.
  • Example Translation: Tình bạn của họ kéo dài nhiều năm.

1108. frighten

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfraɪtn/
  • English Meaning: To make someone feel afraid.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Làm sợ hãi.
  • Example: The loud noise frightened the child.
  • Example Translation: Tiếng động lớn làm đứa trẻ sợ hãi.

1109. frightened

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfraɪtnd/
  • English Meaning: Feeling afraid.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hoảng sợ.
  • Example: She looked frightened.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy trông rất sợ hãi.

1110. frightening

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfraɪtnɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: Making people feel afraid.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đáng sợ.
  • Example: It was a frightening experience.
  • Example Translation: Đó là một trải nghiệm đáng sợ.

1111. frog

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /frɑːɡ/
  • English Meaning: A small animal that lives both on land and in water.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Con ếch.
  • Example: The frog jumped into the pond.
  • Example Translation: Con ếch nhảy xuống ao.

1112. from

  • Type: Preposition
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /frəm/
  • English Meaning: Showing where something starts or originates.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Từ.
  • Example: She comes from Vietnam.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đến từ Việt Nam.

1113. front

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /frʌnt/
  • English Meaning: The forward-facing part of something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mặt trước; phía trước.
  • Example: The car is parked in front of the house.
  • Example Translation: Chiếc xe đậu trước ngôi nhà.

1114. frozen

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfroʊzn/
  • English Meaning: Turned into ice or kept at a very low temperature.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đông lạnh.
  • Example: We bought frozen seafood.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi mua hải sản đông lạnh.

1115. fruit

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fruːt/
  • English Meaning: The sweet product of a plant that contains seeds.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Trái cây.
  • Example: Fruit is good for your health.
  • Example Translation: Trái cây tốt cho sức khỏe.

1116. fry

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /fraɪ/
  • English Meaning: To cook food in hot oil.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chiên; rán.
  • Example: She fried some eggs for breakfast.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy chiên vài quả trứng cho bữa sáng.

1117. fuel

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1, B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfjuːəl/
  • English Meaning: Material used to produce energy.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhiên liệu.
  • Example: Rising fuel prices affect transportation costs.
  • Example Translation: Giá nhiên liệu tăng ảnh hưởng đến chi phí vận chuyển.

1118. full

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /fʊl/
  • English Meaning: Containing as much as possible.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đầy.
  • Example: The restaurant was full.
  • Example Translation: Nhà hàng đã kín chỗ.

1119. fully

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfʊli/
  • English Meaning: Completely.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hoàn toàn.
  • Example: I fully understand your concern.
  • Example Translation: Tôi hoàn toàn hiểu mối lo ngại của bạn.

1120. fun

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /fʌn/
  • English Meaning: Enjoyment or amusement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Niềm vui; thú vị.
  • Example: The party was a lot of fun.
  • Example Translation: Bữa tiệc rất vui.

1121. function

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1, B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfʌŋkʃən/
  • English Meaning: The purpose of something or how it works.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chức năng.
  • Example: The function of the heart is to pump blood.
  • Example Translation: Chức năng của tim là bơm máu.

1122. fund

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /fʌnd/
  • English Meaning: Money available for a particular purpose.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Quỹ; tài trợ.
  • Example: The project received funding from the government.
  • Example Translation: Dự án nhận được tài trợ từ chính phủ.

1123. fundamental

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˌfʌndəˈmentl/
  • English Meaning: Very important and basic.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cơ bản; nền tảng.
  • Example: Communication is fundamental to teamwork.
  • Example Translation: Giao tiếp là nền tảng của làm việc nhóm.

1124. funding

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfʌndɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: Money provided for a project or activity.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nguồn tài trợ.
  • Example: The project needs more funding.
  • Example Translation: Dự án cần thêm nguồn tài trợ.

1125. funny

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfʌni/
  • English Meaning: Causing laughter or amusement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hài hước; buồn cười.
  • Example: The movie was really funny.
  • Example Translation: Bộ phim rất hài hước.

1126. fur

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /fɜːr/
  • English Meaning: The thick soft hair that covers some animals.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lông thú.
  • Example: The rabbit has soft fur.
  • Example Translation: Con thỏ có bộ lông mềm.

1127. furniture

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər/
  • English Meaning: Large objects such as tables, chairs, and beds.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đồ nội thất.
  • Example: They bought new furniture for the house.
  • Example Translation: Họ đã mua đồ nội thất mới cho ngôi nhà.

1128. further

  • Type: Adjective, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɜːrðər/
  • English Meaning: More distant or additional.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Xa hơn; thêm nữa.
  • Example: Further information will be provided later.
  • Example Translation: Thông tin thêm sẽ được cung cấp sau.

1129. furthermore

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˌfɜːrðərˈmɔːr/
  • English Meaning: In addition; moreover.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hơn nữa.
  • Example: Furthermore, the plan will save money.
  • Example Translation: Hơn nữa, kế hoạch này sẽ tiết kiệm tiền.

1130. future

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfjuːtʃər/
  • English Meaning: The time that is yet to come.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tương lai.
  • Example: She is planning for her future.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đang lên kế hoạch cho tương lai.

1131. funny

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfʌni/
  • English Meaning: Causing laughter or amusement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hài hước; buồn cười.
  • Example: The movie was really funny.
  • Example Translation: Bộ phim rất hài hước.

1132. fur

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /fɜːr/
  • English Meaning: The thick soft hair that covers some animals.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lông thú.
  • Example: The rabbit has soft fur.
  • Example Translation: Con thỏ có bộ lông mềm.

1133. furniture

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər/
  • English Meaning: Large objects such as tables, chairs, and beds.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đồ nội thất.
  • Example: They bought new furniture for the house.
  • Example Translation: Họ đã mua đồ nội thất mới cho ngôi nhà.

1134. further

  • Type: Adjective, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈfɜːrðər/
  • English Meaning: More distant or additional.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Xa hơn; thêm nữa.
  • Example: Further information will be provided later.
  • Example Translation: Thông tin thêm sẽ được cung cấp sau.

1135. furthermore

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˌfɜːrðərˈmɔːr/
  • English Meaning: In addition; moreover.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hơn nữa.
  • Example: Furthermore, the plan will save money.
  • Example Translation: Hơn nữa, kế hoạch này sẽ tiết kiệm tiền.

1136. future

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈfjuːtʃər/
  • English Meaning: The time that is yet to come.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tương lai.
  • Example: She is planning for her future.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đang lên kế hoạch cho tương lai.

1137. gain

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ɡeɪn/
  • English Meaning: To obtain or achieve something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đạt được; lợi ích.
  • Example: He gained valuable experience.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy đã đạt được kinh nghiệm quý giá.

1138. gallery

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡæləri/
  • English Meaning: A place where artworks are displayed.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phòng trưng bày.
  • Example: We visited an art gallery.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi đã thăm một phòng trưng bày nghệ thuật.

1139. game

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ɡeɪm/
  • English Meaning: An activity played for fun or competition.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Trò chơi.
  • Example: The children played a game together.
  • Example Translation: Bọn trẻ cùng chơi một trò chơi.

1140. gang

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ɡæŋ/
  • English Meaning: A group of people involved in criminal activities.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Băng nhóm.
  • Example: Police arrested members of the gang.
  • Example Translation: Cảnh sát đã bắt các thành viên của băng nhóm.

1141. gap

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɡæp/
  • English Meaning: An empty space or difference.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Khoảng trống; khoảng cách.
  • Example: There is a gap between the two buildings.
  • Example Translation: Có một khoảng trống giữa hai tòa nhà.

1142. garage

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɡəˈrɑːʒ/
  • English Meaning: A building where vehicles are kept.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà để xe; gara.
  • Example: The car is parked in the garage.
  • Example Translation: Chiếc xe được đậu trong gara.

1143. garbage

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡɑːrbɪdʒ/
  • English Meaning: Waste material that is thrown away.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Rác.
  • Example: Please take out the garbage.
  • Example Translation: Hãy mang rác ra ngoài.

1144. garden

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡɑːrdn/
  • English Meaning: A piece of land used for growing plants.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Khu vườn.
  • Example: She grows flowers in her garden.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy trồng hoa trong khu vườn của mình.

1145. gas

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɡæs/
  • English Meaning: A substance like air or fuel used for heating and vehicles.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Khí đốt; xăng.
  • Example: The car needs more gas.
  • Example Translation: Chiếc xe cần thêm xăng.

1146. gate

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɡeɪt/
  • English Meaning: A movable barrier at an entrance.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cổng.
  • Example: Meet me at the gate.
  • Example Translation: Hãy gặp tôi ở cổng.

1147. gather

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡæðər/
  • English Meaning: To bring people or things together.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tập hợp; thu thập.
  • Example: People gathered in the hall.
  • Example Translation: Mọi người tập trung trong hội trường.

1148. gender

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒendər/
  • English Meaning: The state of being male, female, or another identity.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Giới tính.
  • Example: The study examined gender differences.
  • Example Translation: Nghiên cứu xem xét sự khác biệt giới tính.

1149. general

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒenrəl/
  • English Meaning: Affecting most people or things.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tổng quát; chung.
  • Example: That's a general rule.
  • Example Translation: Đó là một quy tắc chung.

1150. generally

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒenrəli/
  • English Meaning: Usually; in most cases.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nói chung.
  • Example: People generally agree with the idea.
  • Example Translation: Mọi người nhìn chung đồng ý với ý tưởng đó.

1151. generate

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒenəreɪt/
  • English Meaning: To produce or create something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tạo ra.
  • Example: The project generated new opportunities.
  • Example Translation: Dự án đã tạo ra những cơ hội mới.

1152. generation

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃən/
  • English Meaning: People born and living at about the same time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thế hệ.
  • Example: The younger generation uses technology daily.
  • Example Translation: Thế hệ trẻ sử dụng công nghệ hằng ngày.

1153. generous

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒenərəs/
  • English Meaning: Willing to give money, help, or time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hào phóng.
  • Example: She is very generous with her time.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy rất hào phóng về thời gian của mình.

1154. genre

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈʒɑːnrə/
  • English Meaning: A category of art, music, literature, or film.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thể loại.
  • Example: Science fiction is my favorite genre.
  • Example Translation: Khoa học viễn tưởng là thể loại yêu thích của tôi.

1155. gentle

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒentl/
  • English Meaning: Kind, calm, and not rough.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dịu dàng.
  • Example: She has a gentle voice.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy có giọng nói dịu dàng.

1156. geography

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /dʒiˈɑːɡrəfi/
  • English Meaning: The study of the Earth's surface and places.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Địa lý.
  • Example: Geography is my favorite subject.
  • Example Translation: Địa lý là môn học yêu thích của tôi.

1157. get

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ɡet/
  • English Meaning: To receive, obtain, or become.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhận được; có được.
  • Example: I got a gift from my friend.
  • Example Translation: Tôi nhận được một món quà từ bạn tôi.

1158. ghost

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɡoʊst/
  • English Meaning: The spirit of a dead person.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ma; hồn ma.
  • Example: The story was about a ghost.
  • Example Translation: Câu chuyện kể về một hồn ma.

1159. giant

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈdʒaɪənt/
  • English Meaning: Extremely large.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Khổng lồ.
  • Example: They built a giant statue.
  • Example Translation: Họ đã xây một bức tượng khổng lồ.

1160. gift

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ɡɪft/
  • English Meaning: Something given to someone without payment.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Món quà.
  • Example: She received a birthday gift.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy nhận được một món quà sinh nhật.

1161. girl

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ɡɜːrl/
  • English Meaning: A female child or young woman.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bé gái; cô gái.
  • Example: The girl is reading a book.
  • Example Translation: Cô bé đang đọc một cuốn sách.

1162. girlfriend

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡɜːrlfrend/
  • English Meaning: A woman or girl someone is having a romantic relationship with.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bạn gái.
  • Example: He went to the movie with his girlfriend.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy đi xem phim cùng bạn gái.

1163. give

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ɡɪv/
  • English Meaning: To hand something to someone.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cho; đưa.
  • Example: She gave me a gift.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đã tặng tôi một món quà.

1164. glad

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ɡlæd/
  • English Meaning: Pleased and happy.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Vui mừng.
  • Example: I'm glad to hear the news.
  • Example Translation: Tôi vui khi nghe tin đó.

1165. glass

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ɡlæs/
  • English Meaning: A hard transparent material or a drinking container.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thủy tinh; cốc.
  • Example: She drank a glass of water.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy uống một cốc nước.

1166. global

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈɡloʊbəl/
  • English Meaning: Relating to the whole world.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Toàn cầu.
  • Example: Climate change is a global issue.

questions.answerText: Words 1201 to 1300 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level. --- 1201. guard - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ɡɑːrd/ - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ɡes/ - English Meaning: To give an answer without being sure. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đoán. - Example: Can you guess the answer? - Example Translation: Bạn có thể đoán câu trả lời không? 1203. guest - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ɡest/ - English Meaning: A person invited to visit or attend something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khách; khách mời. - Example: We welcomed our guests warmly. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi chào đón khách rất nồng nhiệt. 1204. guide - Vietnamese Meaning: Gót chân. - Example: My heel hurts after running. - Example Translation: Gót chân tôi bị đau sau khi chạy. 1244. height - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /haɪt/ - English Meaning: The measurement from bottom to top. -
